args.head: fix-bankers-rounding
args.title: Fix banker's rounding in round_money (FIN-212)
args.body:
The nightly build fails because `tests/test_money.py` expects banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN, per FIN-212), but `src/money.py` was using ROUND_HALF_UP.

This change switches `round_money` to use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` so that values like 2.665 round to 2.66 (banker's rounding) as required.

authority: Merging into main requires approval from a code owner
